page_title: OSA 0-1 VAL | Osasuna v Valencia 15/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+7' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the middle of the target. His effort isn't powerful nor precise enough, allowing Giorgi Mamardashvili to keep the ball out of the net.
90+7' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+6' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Osasuna!

90+4' There's a break in play and referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Osasuna using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+3' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+3' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
90+2' Pepelu (Valencia) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Pepelu (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
88' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
88' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Thierry Correia (Valencia).
88' The game has come to an end for Javi Guerra. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Selim Amallah (Valencia).
87' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:4.
85' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
83' David Garcia (Osasuna) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
82' Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
80' A player from Valencia pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
79' Ruben Baraja is forced to make a change. Fran Perez (Valencia) is unable to continue due to injury, Peter Gonzalez comes on.
78' Fran Perez (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Javi Guerra (Valencia) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
76' A substitution has been made. Jose Manuel Arnaiz is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).

75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) for Andre Almeida.
75' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

73' Some patient build-up play from Osasuna as they look to unlock the defence.
72' 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.

68' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
66' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
65' Ruben Garcia dinks a lofted pass into the path of Ante Budimir (Osasuna) inside the box, but his drive sails a whisker past the left post.
62' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.

50' The attendance is 19480.

48' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Ruben Baraja, then shows him a yellow.
45' Fran Perez (Valencia) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
43' Pepelu (Valencia) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
42' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
41' Osasuna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
40' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) fires in a shot from the edge of the box which deflects off one of the defending players and hits the left post!
39' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the corner with a short pass.
39' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
39' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
38' Osasuna are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
36' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is flagged for offside.
36' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ante Budimir (Osasuna) heads on.
32' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
31' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:2.
25' A wild effort from Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
24' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.

21' What a wasted opportunity by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
20' The Valencia players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
18' 0 - 1 Andre Almeida (Valencia) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
17' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is able to continue to play.
16' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' The ball is cleared after Hugo Duro (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Pepelu (Valencia), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
7' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
6' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
4' Valencia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
2' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
